title: galeopsis ladanum subsp. cebennensis
intro: Galeopsis ladanum subsp. cebennensis, commonly known as the fragrant knapweed, is a plant species in the mint family (Lamiaceae). It is valued for its medicinal properties and used to treat various health conditions. The plant has been traditionally used to treat digestive issues, skin problems, and respiratory issues due to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties. The bioactive constituents of Galeopsis ladanum subsp. cebennensis include terpenoids, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory effects.
